Package com.lemarketjames.reports.insight

Class VolumeInsightController

java.lang.Object
com.lemarketjames.reports.insight.VolumeInsightController
@RestController @RequestMapping("/api/v1/reports/insights") public class VolumeInsightController extends Object
Insights for analysts. Access needs no code here: every path under /api/v1/reports/ is ANALYST-only in SecurityConfig (contract C7).
